supported: The positive N_eff coefficient is not explained away by conditioning on growth over the preceding one or two annual intervals.
The lag1+lag2 coefficient remains unusual under the same full-series island-wise circular-shift null family used for the original coefficient.
The same qualitative result holds in the exact 416-member shift group preserving N_eff covariance among the four persistent islands.
Incremental held-out-year MSE improvement becomes smaller after conditioning on two years of demographic momentum.
not_supported: causal inference that colony organization determines growth
a claim that two lagged growth controls remove all time-varying confounding
ecological_interpretation: Effective colony number retains a small positive association with next-year island growth after recent demographic momentum is controlled, so the signal is not well described as a proxy for continuing decline alone. Its incremental held-out predictive contribution is nevertheless very small and becomes smaller with two lagged growth terms.
